question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I would __complain to my__ grandfather about him.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the verb form is correct.
 
• The sentence structure follows **standard grammatical rules and does not require any changes.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *I would complain to my grandfather about him*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When a sentence is grammatically correct, it is important to identify that no changes are needed.
 
 
• **Example:** *The cat sat on the mat*.
 
 
 
• Understanding when no improvement is necessary is crucial in grammar exercises.
 
 
• Example: *She runs every morning*.
